name: SEIZE OBJ KHADRA
brief: TASK FORCE, THIS IS HIGHER. Welcome to the First Team. West of the river sits a crossroads suburb designated OBJECTIVE KHADRA. Intel holds SUSPECTED enemy positions inside — the markers on your map are where we THINK they are, not where they stand. Nothing is fielded at H-hour: your battalion stages from CP LONGKNIFE. Open the FORCES rail on the left edge and CALL UP your scout platoon first — scouts find the enemy before the enemy finds you. Set them to BREAK in the bottom tray so they fall back if engaged, then RIGHT-CLICK to push them toward the objective. Behind them, call up an assault force — two mech platoons and the mortars are a solid start. Use ATTACK posture to close with the enemy, clear the suburb, then move in and DIG IN. Expect a counterattack from the north once you hold the town. FIND THEM. CLEAR OBJ KHADRA. HOLD IT.

radio.text: COUNTERATTACK INBOUND — HOSTILE ARMOR MOVING ON THE SUBURB FROM THE NORTH. HOLD WHAT YOU TOOK.
